#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    string s;
    cin >> s;
    int* temp = new int[n]();
    int count = 0;
    int k = 0;
    bool inside = (s[0] == '(');
    int i = 0;

    while (i < n) {
        char c = s[i];
        if (!inside) {
            if (c == '_') {
                k++;
            } else {
                if (c == '(') {
                    inside = true;
                } else {
                    temp[k]++;
                }
            }
        } else {
            if (c == ')') {
                inside = false;
                k++;
            } else if (i > 0 && (s[i-1] == '(' || s[i-1] == '_') && c != '_' && c != '(') {
                count++;
            }
        }
        i++;
    }

    for (int a = 0; a < n; a++) {
        for (int b = a; b > 0; b--) {
            if (temp[b] > temp[b-1]) {
                int swap = temp[b];
                temp[b] = temp[b-1];
                temp[b-1] = swap;
            }
        }
    }

    cout << temp[0] << endl;
    cout << count << endl;

    delete[] temp;
    return 0;
}
